content.title: Chapter 102 - UTILITIES — Sec. 102-135. - Discharge of groundwater in sanitary sewers prohibited.
content.summary:
It is unlawful for any person to discharge precipitation runoff from roof downspouts
               or stormwater collection systems or subsurface groundwater from such sources as foundation
               drainage systems and sump pumps into the city sanitary sewer system.
